question: How does one now wish to hear the auspicious deception of time?
premises: The speaker now wishes to hear.
The object is the auspicious deception of time.
inference: The verse frames the teaching as a timely request to learn time's auspicious deception.
uncertainties: Whether vañcanaṃ is object of śrotum or part of a larger compound phrase.
plain_english: Now I wish to hear the auspicious deception of time.
